Examined all supplied documentation excerpts, file metadata, three dependency-pointer changes and the benchmark patch against the canonical definition index and supplied T-041 details. docs/reference/configuration.md:441 documents GatedDeltaPrefill in MLXLMCommon, probe-based bitwise comparison, forced measurement kernels and stock decode/MTP/masked updates. The complete range map identifies only this row and the update date as changed; surrounding cache, memory, media, token, attestation and helper settings are not new controls in this batch. No concrete security regression follows from the documentation edit.
BackendParityHarness.swift:435 explicitly selects MLXLLM.Gemma4AssistantDraftModel while retaining the visible target-type check and drafter construction. This is benchmark code; the excerpt does not establish changed serving authorization, artifact validation or model behavior.
libs/mlx:1, libs/mlx-swift:1 and libs/mlx-swift-lm:1 advance native-runtime dependencies without supplying their implementation diffs. This is a material coverage limit, not evidence of safety or a vulnerability. Integration must examine those revision deltas and their combined provider behavior, particularly GatedDelta kernel bounds, masked/recurrent state isolation and numerical equivalence (TB-007, T-007, T-027), allocation/admission and cancellation, residual request data (T-028), and cache scope/authentication (T-041). Confirm that the explicitly selected assistant retains its loading/validation contract. Nothing visible changes hop encryption, token custody, attestation, billing or privileged fan authority, but dependency effects on these contracts cannot be excluded from pointer changes alone. Deeper review remains necessary for the native dependency updates.
